cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 120 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -25
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page()
    pg.goto("https://dash.allmodels.io/signup",wait_until="domcontentloaded")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(8000)
    print("URL:",pg.url)
    for i,f in enumerate(pg.frames):
        print(f"frame[{i}]:",f.url[:90])
    print("--- elemen turnstile ---")
    for sel in ['iframe','[data-sitekey]','.cf-turnstile','#cf-turnstile','input[name="cf-turnstile-response"]']:
        print(sel,"->",len(pg.query_selector_all(sel)))
    print("--- tombol ---")
    for bt in pg.query_selector_all("button"):
        print(repr(bt.inner_text()[:40]), "disabled=",bt.is_disabled())
    b.close()
